Lighten color

Source: R/AutoScript.R
AS.color.lighten.Rd

Alpha-composites a color over a white background (alpha * color + (1 - alpha) * white).

Usage

AS.color.lighten(color, alpha = 0.5)

Arguments

color

A color, as accepted by grDevices::col2rgb().

alpha

Alpha value of color in the composite, from 0 (fully transparent, returns white) to 1 (fully opaque, returns color unchanged). Default = 0.5.

Value

A hex color string.
